regime_context: As of 2026-07-28, China A‑shares theme momentum shows Semiconductors leading with a narrow margin over AI Compute & Optics. Only 5 of 22 themes are eligible, indicating low participation breadth. The absolute‑trend gate has not historically reduced drawdown in this market (mean‑reverting tape), so trend eligibility alone provides no validated risk control. Innovative Pharma is flagged as crowded. The macro backdrop is AI/tech‑heavy, but all recent headlines were unscheduled (high uncertainty). Past calls here have modest accuracy (direction accuracy ~46%, n=13), so any view must be low‑conviction.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics is the close challenger (score 1.455 vs leader 1.6). If its score overtakes Semiconductors by a margin >0.1 while maintaining an eligible status, a leadership handoff may be forming. Watch for it to become the new #1; kill the watch if Semiconductors retains lead and the margin widens beyond 0.3 over 10 trading days.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors is the current leader (rank 1, score 1.6) with a durability bar of 0.51 and a trend tag, and it is not crowded. Low breadth (0.18) suggests narrow participation, which makes the trend fragile. Because the trend gate has no historical edge here, this overweight is only a tentative continuation of the prevailing narrative.
evidence: gate_helps false (no structural edge from eligibility)
theses.dissent: The low breadth and lack of a validated trend gate raise the risk of a sharp reversal if the narrow leadership breaks; a mean‑reverting tape could punish this continuation lean.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors loses rank #1 to AI Compute by a margin >0.2 AND durability bar drops below 0.4 within 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Despite a high durability bar (0.83) and a trend tag, the theme is crowded (crowding_z 1.21). Crowding is a size‑down caution, not a fade signal, but in a market where the trend gate offers no drawdown protection, the crowded status increases vulnerability. Avoiding this theme reduces crowding risk.
evidence: gate_helps false (no protective gate for drawdowns)
theses.dissent: High durability and a persistent trend could override the crowding concern; Pharma might continue to rally despite being crowded.

falsifier.text: Innovative Pharma's crowding_z falls below 1.0 and breadth remains above 0.8 within 20 days, negating the crowding caution.
